note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Venezuela: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A Venezuelan resident pays income tax on a scale in tax units (TU): 6% to 1,000 TU, rising to 34% above 6,000 TU (Tariff No. 1), after a standard deduction of 774 TU or itemized deductions, less a 10 TU credit plus 10 TU per family member under 25; one TU is VES 43 from 2 June 2025.
figures.applies: 2026; TU value from 2 June 2025 (the 2026 value was not read).

sources.said: As from 2 June 2025, the value of 1 TU is VES 43.
a standard deduction of 774 TUs may be taken. A taxpayer also may deduct 10 TUs for each family member younger than age 25, and an additional 10 TUs overall.
There are no local taxes on personal income in Venezuela.

figures.finding: The employee pays 4% social security on pay up to five minimum wages (employer 9–11%), 0.5% employment benefit (employer 2%) up to ten minimum wages, 1% housing (employer 2%) uncapped, and 0.5% INCES on profit-sharing (employer 2%).
figures.applies: 2026; Deloitte gives the employer's share as 10–12%.

sources.said: Up to five minimum salaries for urban workers 9, 10, or 11 4
Up to ten minimum salaries for urban workers 2 0.5
Total monthly (or integral) salary No cap 2 1

figures.finding: Income tax is withheld from salaries, professional fees, royalties paid to non-residents and certain other payments to non-residents.
figures.applies: Rates for residents' salaries not read.

sources.said: Income tax is withheld from salaries, professional fees, royalties paid to non-residents, and certain other payments received by non-residents.

figures.finding: A non-resident pays a flat 34% withheld at source on salary and other income for services performed in Venezuela, and 34% on 90% of gross fees for non-business professional activities.

sources.said: Salary and other income received by non-residents for services performed in Venezuela are subject to a flat 34% tax, withheld at source.
Income for non-resident individuals arising from non-business professional activities is subject to tax at 34% on 90% of the gross payments.

figures.finding: VAT (IVA) is 16% generally on goods and services rendered in Venezuela; every taxpayer must hold a tax number, and no threshold was found.
Wage earners file on a calendar-year basis by 31 March of the next year.

sources.said: Individual taxpayers earning wages and salaries must file their tax returns on a calendar-year basis
The Venezuelan income tax return should be filed by 31 March
